subject: table: Add option `DupKeyCheckLazy` to check duplicated key lazily (#55246)
summary: Refactors duplicate-key checking to an explicit `table.DupKeyCheckMode` (InPlace/Lazy/Skip), removes session-scoped `PresumeKeyNotExists`/`LazyCheckKeyNotExists`, and updates insert/update/replace/load-data executors to choose lazy vs in-place checks based on txn mode and `tidb_constraint_check_in_place` while preserving IGNORE behavior where immediate dup-key detection is required. Later upstream history includes follow-up refactors (#55360/#55597) but nothing indicating an unresolved Blocker/High issue in this commit.
